subtitle_zm_zzod_zrld/zm_zzod_zrld_rola_: Jawohl. It shall be done.
Message received, loud und clear.
I know what to do. I think.
My work is never done.
Fine. But don’t expect me to salute you.
As the Yanks say, “Roger that.”
Sure. Not that I have much choice.
I’ll get right on it.
One day I’ll stop taking orders. But not today.
I’ll see to it. I always do.
I’ll destroy you for that!
Their strength is inhuman.
Damn you, wiedergänger!
Keep your rancid claws off me!
Scheisse! That hurt!
You really should cut your nails.
You just signed your own death warrant.
You’ll pay for that!
Strike at me, will you?!
I’ll put you down like a rabid dog.
That monkey was a soldier’s soldier.
Exploding ape. And still not the weirdest thing here.
The dead are... easily distracted.
They were drawn to the little fellow. Such charisma.
Monkey, monkey, uber alles.
To all the simians in our company, I salute you.
Back off, schweinehund!
Out of my way!
In deinem Gesicht!
You come at me, you lose.
That’ll teach you to keep your distance.
Ach! They smell so bad!
Filthy wiedergänger.
Come and get it.
Close enough to smell its breath. *gag*
The closer you get, the faster you fall.
No head, no problem.
The light in their eyes makes a perfect target.
I am getting too good at this.
Right between your glowing eyes.
Mindless -- now brainless.
Headshots feel... merciful.
A bullet to the head works.
Must’ve used that brain for something...
Auf weidersehen to your face.
Skull shattered, wiedergänger down.
You see, Sturmkrieger? I shoot back!
I hate bullies. That’s all a Sturmkreiger is.
All sturm and no drang.
Sturmkrieger down.
Size and firepower could not save you.
Like fighting a damn Tiger Tank.
The only good Sturmkrieger’s a dead one.
They just keep coming. But only so far.
I think I used to serve with that guy.
I bet you were great fun at parties. Asshole.
In this war, I take no prisoners.
Lost count of my kills. Not that I would keep a tally...
I will lay them all to rest!
They should have stayed in the grave.
I’m doing my part...
Die, wiedergänger! Every stinking one of you!
A few less soldiers for the thousand-year Reich.
I’m a one-man massacre!
All fall before me.
Dead men ahead of me, corpses in my wake.
Keep your filthy hands off me!
Hit me, I hit back harder.
I only finished what you started.
You had that coming, wiedergänger.
Swing at me, pay the price!
How do you like it, scheisskopf?!
Should’ve killed me when you had a chance.
Told you I’d get even.
Revenge feels good. Not for you.
Paid back. In full.
Out with a bang.
That scream will haunt my nightmares.
God, I hate those Boom-schriers.
Worth it just to shut you up.
That scream. Like nails on a chalkboard.
Damned walking hand grenade...
At least they let you know they’re coming.
Fucking Boom-schrier...
The scream’s almost worse than the blast.
Consider yourself defused!
I think I’ll be needing this.
Interesting...
Can’t let this go to waste.
I can find a use for this.
Look what I found.
Hard to pass up.
You’re coming with me.
I’ll take it.
What a find.
What have we here?
Turns men into mincemeat.
Look away, Herr Professor. I’ll be doing very bad things with this.
Fair warning: you may want to stay out of my way.
It’s lighter than it looks. For me, anyway.
The day just got worse for Von List and his revenants.
Going to make a lot of friends with this.
If I must kill them by hand, so be it.
Not fancy, but it does the job.
If we all fought with these, there would be fewer wars.
Killing with this feels cruel... but honest.
Father carried one like this in the Great War.
I was top marksman in my Wehrmacht unit.
Marksman rifle. Make every shot count.
Basic infantry weapon. It’ll do.
A soldier’s best friend.
Hits like a right cross from Max Schmeling.
Good for duck hunting. Or blowing the heads off revenants.
Shotgun. Sometimes simple is best.
Get too close and you’ll regret it...
12 gauge. My favorite gauge.
Fast und loud. That usually works.
Been fond of these since I held my first MP 40.
This will make a mess of the rotten schweine.
Maschinenpistole. I’ll be needing lots of bullets...
A bit light for my taste, but vicious nonetheless.
I used to think snipers were cowards. Not anymore.
Sniping is not my strength, but I’ll manage.
This rifle takes skill and patience.
I didn’t go to sniper school. But it’s never to late to learn...
Revenants look even worse through a scope.
Das sturmgewehr. My favorite.
Such rifles and I are fast friends.
Germans invented assault rifles. We do not mess around.
Ugly weapon for an ugly job...
Oh, this feels good in my hands.
I’m not running around here empty-handed.
Sehr gut. But then, I’m a gun-half-full kind of guy.
I have won battles with lesser weapons...
I overcome the enemy with whatever’s at hand.
I’m a man without a country, but not without a weapon.
Well, dämon, I hope you enjoyed that.
Dämon, consider that a promotion.
I’ll use this power for good. Or at least to stay alive.
Now we’ll lay waste to the enemy.
Black hearts as legal tender. What a world.
Dämon -- don’t say I never did anything for you.
I gave you power, dämon. Repay the favor.
I was never much for books, but this one I like.
Whoever printed that book, it sure wasn’t Gutenberg.
The book that eats human hearts. I’ll never get over that.
I think I got the best of that deal.
Not bad... for a deal with a devil.
Good deal. But I could do without the gruesome theatrics.
What’s the exchange rate: corrupted hearts to Deutsche Marks?
Worth the price I paid.
Not the first time I gave my heart away.
I paid my pound of flesh. Literally.
Worth every pfennig. Well... every ventricle.
“Necessary evil” describes this altar perfectly.
Pleasure doing business, you hideous thing.
I’m hit!
They dragged me down!
Achtung! I am down!
Get me back in the fight!
Hilfe! I need assistance.
The filthy things dropped me!
I’m hurt -- come quick!
Ach! I got overconfident.
That was wunderbar! Keep it up.
You show no mercy.
Ja, soldier. Hold nothing back.
I’ll be staying out of your way.
What you just did? Keep doing that.
No half measures for you.
I’m sticking close to you.
Yes! Teach them fear.
I’ll have to try harder to keep up.
Nicely done, soldat.
Still not as bad as American beer.
Ooh. Feels a bit... tingly...
That was... better than expected.
*shudder* Straight to my bowels...
The pills the Wehrmacht gave us weren’t half as strong as this.
Like absinthe... mixed with vomit.
This makes my tongue itch. I don’t want to know why.
Is there a way to bottle this stuff?
I guess I really will drink anything...
Tastes like demon piss.
Happens to the best of us.
I could not leave you there.
We get through this together.
I’m sure you’ll repay the favor.
Mother wanted me to be a doctor.
Up you go.
Looking better already.
The professor needs us all alive.
You’re a goo squad mate.
Dankeschön.
I was getting worried there...
Good soldier.
That is teamwork.
I’ll remember this.
Most kind of you.
That was close.
A temporary victory, but I’ll gladly take it.
And they said I would never amount to anything.
I won’t let this go to my head.
Every day I’m still alive is a victory.
